description: This file defines the 'OrderProductEntity' class, extending 'OrderProduct', which encapsulates additional order-related details such as quantity and product information, and implements Serializable.

classes.name: OrderProductEntity
classes.description: A Java class representing an order item with quantity and product details, extendable from OrderProduct, and serializable for persistence or transfer.

methods.name: setOrderedQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product ordered.

methods.name: getOrderedQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the product ordered.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the product information associated with this order item.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Sets the product information associated with this order item.
